-- 获取原始信贷数据
WITH loan_records AS (
  SELECT 
  ktp as ktp_no,
  user_reference_code as report_no,
  file_exist as status,
  substr(create_time,1,10) as create_time,
  CONCAT(
    SUBSTRING(get_json_object(result, '$.header.tanggalHasil'), 1, 4), '-',     -- 年
    SUBSTRING(get_json_object(result, '$.header.tanggalHasil'), 5, 2), '-',     -- 月
    SUBSTRING(get_json_object(result, '$.header.tanggalHasil'), 7, 2), ' ',
    SUBSTRING(get_json_object(result, '$.header.tanggalHasil'), 9, 2), ':',
    SUBSTRING(get_json_object(result, '$.header.tanggalHasil'), 11, 2), ':',
    SUBSTRING(get_json_object(result, '$.header.tanggalHasil'), 13, 2)
    ) as report_update_time,
  explode(
    from_json(
      get_json_object(result, '$.individual.fasilitas.kreditPembiayan'),
      'array<string>'
    )
  ) as loan_record
  FROM risk.ods__credit_datafetch_slik_id_db__slik_report_history_tab__df
  WHERE grass_date = '${ds}' AND substr(create_time, 1, 10) >= date_sub('${ds}', 90)
),
final_tab as (
SELECT
  null as trace_id,
  null as credit_user_id,
  null as platform_user_id,
  null as flow_no,
  ktp_no,
  report_no,
  status,
  null as is_error,
  create_time,
  report_update_time,
  get_json_object(loan_record, '$.ljk') as reporter_ljk_id,
  get_json_object(loan_record, '$.ljkKet') as reporter,
  get_json_object(loan_record, '$.kondisiKet') as condition,
  get_json_object(loan_record, '$.kondisi') as condition_id,
  get_json_object(loan_record, '$.kualitasKet') as quality,

  get_json_object(loan_record, '$.jenisKreditPembiayaanKet') as creditor_category,

  get_json_object(loan_record, '$.akadKreditPembiayaanKet') as credit_contract,
  get_json_object(loan_record, '$.akadKreditPembiayaan') as credit_contract_id,
  get_json_object(loan_record, '$.plafon') as loan_amt,
  get_json_object(loan_record, '$.plafonAwal') as initial_loan_amt,
  get_json_object(loan_record, '$.bakiDebet') as os_amt,
